About

SRG Housing Finance Ltd, established
in 1999, is an NHB-registered housing
finance company focused on affordable
housing finance for rural and semi-urban borrowers. Products cover home purchase,
self-construction, renovation, extension and Loan Against Property (LAP). Company serves 25,000+ customers through 96 branches.[1]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1][2]
SRG Housing Finance is a leading rural
housing finance company, focusing on
New-to-Credit, Underserved & Unorganized population. They offer small ticket loans,
tailored products, and simplified access
to finance through minimal documentation
and fast processing.
As of FY26, they operated 96 branches across 7 states with an AUM of Rs 1,04.2 Cr
